thread:
deploybot: :rotating_light: release-check failed for release v2.14.0 -> secret mismatch detected in credential namespaces
deploybot: details: secret 'redwood-credentials' exists in 'infer-staging' but missing in 'infra-prod' (expected by release manifest)
anya: wait what — how did that get out of sync? we run the same keystore-sync job during rollout
sam: saw a 404 on prod when hitting model registry auth during canary, thought it was intermittent, logging now shows token fetch fails
kai: can you paste the deploybot output?
deploybot: ```
---
check: keystore-namespace-parity
path: /manifests/services/inference/credentials
expected_namespace: infra-prod
found_namespace: infer-staging
status: mismatch
recommendation: block_release
---
```
maria: from a quick grep, the helm values for v2.14 had a conditional that set credentialNamespace to {{ .Values.env.namespace | default "infer-staging" }} — looks like a default slipped through the chart override
anya: ohhhh that default was added during the chart refactor last month, we pinned it in staging values but forgot prod override in the release bundle
oncall-sre: pinging @oncall-sre for visibility — if prod can't read creds this will fail 100% of requests after promotion
oncall-sre: thanks, i'm on it. can we pause the promotion?
sam: deploybot currently marked the release as blocked, UI shows status: BLOCKED by preflight - keystore namespace mismatch
kai: options: 1) backfill secret into infra-prod namespace (fast, but manual), 2) patch helm values and re-run promotion (safer), 3) rollback to previous pinned release image (if already promoted)
anya: what's the ETA for a backfill? small change to copy secret, but need approvers and audit notes. i can do it in ~15min if we approve
maria: prefer patching the values in the release artifact to avoid reintroducing drift next time. but rolling that out takes a minute to update the bundle and re-run preflight
oncall-sre: for safety pause and backfill so canary remains stable. then we can do a proper releasepatch that updates values and logs the change in release notes
sam: agree with pause + backfill. keep prod untouched except the secret copy. can we audit that copy with a short runbook note?
anya: i'll do the backfill and create a PR to update helm values in the release branch. copying steps here:```bash
kubectl -n infer-staging get secret redwood-credentials -o yaml | sed 's/namespace: infer-staging/namespace: infra-prod/' | kubectl apply -f -
```
anya: will tag the change with `release/2.14.0-keystore-namespace-fix` and link the PR in this thread
kai: add a note to release notes: "fixed missing prod override for credentialNamespace; manual backfill applied to infra-prod to restore auth during promotion"
oncall-sre: also add an incident tag + audit id once done
deploybot: release promotion paused by user request (reason: keystore namespace parity). preflight: BLOCKED
sam: thanks. @anya please post once the copy is done and we can re-run preflight. if anything looks off i'll be ready to roll back the canary image
anya: done — secret copied and a short audit entry created: AUDIT-2026-4598. PR: https://git.redwood/release/2.14.0/keystore-namespace-fix (waiting review)
anya: re-running deploybot preflight now...
deploybot: preflight passed after keystore parity fix. status: UNBLOCKED
kai: excellent. maria, please include the change in the release notes and add the follow-up ticket to ensure helm values are validated in CI (prevent default namespace escape)
maria: on it. created ticket INF-1327 "validate credentialNamespace overrides in release bundles" and added to next sprint
sam: final check: promote to prod window at 17:00 UTC as planned? we should also schedule a short smoke window post-promotion to verify model registry auth
oncall-sre: yes schedule smoke for +10m after promotion, i'll coordinate SRE runbook
anya: thanks all, closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
